Scenario fixture: aria-role-conformance (RGAA 8.2.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form arc_case_NN. Expected outcomes follow the W3C validator 26.9.27: every FAIL case is an error there, every PASS case is not. Hidden content is checked too.

A. Role values the validator rejects (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: role token that is not a role, on a button
02 — FAIL: unknown token in a list with a valid fallback
Open
03 — FAIL: role written with capitals
Open
04 — FAIL: abstract role
Open
05 — FAIL: empty role attribute
Text

B. Roles not allowed on the element (FAIL)

06 — FAIL: role="tab" on a nav
Tab
07 — FAIL: role="button" on a heading

Heading

08 — FAIL: any role on a td of a native table
Cell
09 — FAIL: a role other than listitem on an li of a ul
  • Item
10 — FAIL: a role on the summary of a details
MoreContent

C. Images with a role (FAIL, CANTTELL)

11 — FAIL: img with a role and alt=""
12 — FAIL: img with a role and no alt, aria-label or aria-labelledby
13 — CANTTELL: img with role="presentation" and alt="", which RGAA 1.2.1 names for decorative images

D. Hidden content (FAIL)

14 — FAIL: unknown role inside a hidden container
Hidden
15 — FAIL: role not allowed, inside a display:none container
Hidden tab

E. Valid roles (PASS)

16 — PASS: role="button" on a div
Open
17 — PASS: two valid tokens (the second is a fallback)
Layout
18 — PASS: role="tab" on an li whose list has role="tablist"
  • Tab
19 — PASS: role="button" on an img with a text alternative
20 — PASS: role="tab" on a heading, which ARIA in HTML allows

Section
